utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Dane, I’m keeping the repair list current, and I’ll give everyone a clear update this afternoon on what’s done and what’s still pending.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Eli—good call keeping the list tight. I’m headed over to Leo’s porch to help Sam with the tables and toolbox setup.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Dane—that keeps things orderly. Let me know what gets set up at Leo’s porch, and I’ll add it to the afternoon update.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ve got it as 9 a.m. in the school parking lot, and I’m heading over right after school drop-off. I only heard spare cords and small appliances, but I can double-check once I’m there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, that sounds right—school lot at 9, and if anything weird comes up just tag it and drop it at Leo’s porch before 6.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect—I’ll head over after drop-off and let you know if they mention anything besides cords and small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Gus, bring anything that needs fixing to my porch, and if you can, help Sam with the tables when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Leo—I’ll bring over the items that need fixing and give Sam a hand with the tables when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good—just stack the repairs by the porch steps and check in with Sam when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m all set to help, Rosa—I’ll be at Leo’s porch around 5 to get the tables set up and the basic tools sorted.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam—that changed, so please skip Leo’s porch and plan for Sunday at the community center instead; can you still help set up tables and basic tools there?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course, Rosa—I can do Sunday at the community center and help set up the tables and basic tools there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Uli, before I commit, can we confirm it’s still Saturday afternoon and just for bikes, small appliances, and wobbly furniture?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I only know it’s still Saturday afternoon, and the folding tables still need repair; Sam said he’d bring the basic tools. Rosa would know for certain if it’s just bikes, small appliances, and wobbly furniture.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—that helps. Before I jump in, can we check with Rosa whether folding tables are included, or if we’re still just doing bikes, small appliances, and wobbly furniture?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Cleo—that helps a ton. If you spot the Millers or Jo, send them along too and remind them we’ll be fixing things all afternoon Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely—I’ll flag down the Millers and Jo if I see them, and I’ll let them know the repair drive’s on all afternoon Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Cleo—that’ll keep the word moving, and with luck we’ll have the Millers and Jo bringing things by this Saturday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Pia, before we plan anything, can you get me the organizer’s name and a direct confirmation on the date and pickup details?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don’t have the organizer’s name yet, and I’m not comfortable planning around the drive until we get direct confirmation on the date and pickup details today.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay—please get me a named contact and direct confirmation on the date and pickup details today, and then we can move forward.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Kira—I’m still out running errands, so just keep me posted this afternoon on what gets fixed and what’s still left.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure, but are we actually certain the repair drive is happening, and who confirmed the date and pickup details?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out running errands, so I can’t confirm those details firsthand—please check with whoever’s coordinating on-site and let me know this afternoon what’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ve been telling everyone the same thing: keep an eye out for the date, and once we hear it, we’ll spread the word fast.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik—that helps a ton. We’re set for Saturday afternoon, focused on bikes, small appliances, and wobbly furniture, so please go ahead and spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect—I’ll start telling people it’s Saturday afternoon for bikes, small appliances, and wobbly furniture, and to pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Tess, would you mind confirming it’s this Saturday at 9 in the school parking lot? I keep worrying I’ll muddle it and bring the wrong things.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, yes—this Saturday at 9 in the school parking lot, and you’re not muddling it a bit. Bring along anything that needs fixing, and I’ll keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, whew, thanks, Tess—that helps a lot. I’ll bring the spare cords and little appliances, then, and try not to overthink it again.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still telling folks it’s Saturday afternoon for bikes, small appliances, and wobbly furniture, with a rough headcount only.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That matches what I’ve heard—so far I only know the folding tables still need repair, and Sam said he’d bring the basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect—that all fits; I’ll keep spreading the word and let folks know we’re still keeping the headcount rough for Saturday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Nell, I’ve updated it to Sunday at the community center, and Leo’s porch drop-off time is still on hold for now.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks—I’d only heard bits before, so I’ll start passing along that it’s Sunday at the community center and keep Leo’s drop-off as still up in the air.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect—that matches what I’ve got noted, so if you hear a new drop-off time for Leo, send it my way.
